description: Cboe Global Markets, Inc., which describes itself as the world's leading derivatives and securities exchange network, delivers trading, clearing and investment solutions to people around the world, providing trading solutions and products in multiple asset classes including equities, derivatives and foreign exchange across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Its subsidiaries include the largest options exchange and the third largest equities exchange operator in the United States, and it is committed to building a trusted, inclusive global marketplace that enables people to pursue a sustainable financial future. It reports five segments, and its Cboe Data Vantage business includes access and capacity fees to its markets, proprietary market data fees from various licensing agreements and proprietary indices, and other data and access products and services.
